# LassTreffen.at

> LassTreffen.at is an Austrian event discovery platform covering all 9 Austrian Bundesländer. It aggregates ~70,000 upcoming events from ~140 data sources — concerts, festivals, markets, cultural events, university talks, sports, family activities, nightlife — and presents them on an interactive Mapbox map alongside a social layer (friend plans, direct messages, shared memories, artist-follow alerts). The platform is in German, focuses on Austria, and is free for end users.

**Editorial integrity:** every event links back to its original source. Events are deduplicated, geocoded against the official Austrian gemeinde registry (~2,100 municipalities), and enriched with structured data (Schema.org Event JSON-LD, Open Graph, Twitter Cards).

**Publisher:** Jonathan Panao-Rottensteiner — panaemonium141099 on GitHub. Contact via [/impressum](https://lasstreffen.at/impressum).

## Main navigation

- [Homepage](https://lasstreffen.at): Weekly highlights, region explorer, popular categories
- [Interactive map](https://lasstreffen.at/entdecken): Mapbox GL JS view with bbox filter, category/date filters
- [Event calendar](https://lasstreffen.at/calendar): User's saved + followed events in a calendar view (auth required)
- [Blog](https://lasstreffen.at/blog): 50+ editorial guides to Austrian festivals and event series
- [Sources](https://lasstreffen.at/quellen): Transparency page listing all ~140 data sources
- [About](https://lasstreffen.at/ueber-uns): Platform purpose, methodology, contact

## Bundesland hubs (9 regions)

- [Wien](https://lasstreffen.at/wien): Events in Vienna, all categories
- [Niederösterreich](https://lasstreffen.at/niederoesterreich): Events in Lower Austria
- [Oberösterreich](https://lasstreffen.at/oberoesterreich): Events in Upper Austria
- [Steiermark](https://lasstreffen.at/steiermark): Events in Styria
- [Tirol](https://lasstreffen.at/tirol): Events in Tyrol
- [Salzburg](https://lasstreffen.at/salzburg): Events in Salzburg
- [Kärnten](https://lasstreffen.at/kaernten): Events in Carinthia
- [Vorarlberg](https://lasstreffen.at/vorarlberg): Events in Vorarlberg
- [Burgenland](https://lasstreffen.at/burgenland): Events in Burgenland

## Theme hubs (Austria-wide)

- [Konzerte, Festivals & Live-Musik](https://lasstreffen.at/thema/musik): Music events Austria-wide
- [Kultur & Bühne](https://lasstreffen.at/thema/kultur): Theatre, visual arts, cabaret
- [Nightlife & Party](https://lasstreffen.at/thema/nightlife): Clubs, DJ sets, after-shows
- [Essen & Trinken](https://lasstreffen.at/thema/kulinarik): Heurige, wine festivals, food events
- [Märkte & Feste](https://lasstreffen.at/thema/maerkte): Flea markets, village festivals, Advent markets
- [Sport & Bewegung](https://lasstreffen.at/thema/sport): Runs, games, tournaments
- [Natur & Abenteuer](https://lasstreffen.at/thema/natur): Hiking, climbing, outdoor
- [Wissen & Karriere](https://lasstreffen.at/thema/bildung): Lectures, workshops, trade fairs
- [Familie & Kinder](https://lasstreffen.at/thema/familie): Family + kid events
- [Community & Freizeit](https://lasstreffen.at/thema/community): Meetups, clubs, Stammtische
- [Wellness & Spiritualität](https://lasstreffen.at/thema/wellness): Yoga, meditation, retreats

## Data model + structure

- Every event has: title, start_date (ISO with AT timezone), end_date (optional), location_name, address, latitude, longitude, category (one of 12 taxonomy v3 values), tags (multi), description, source_url, optional ticket_url
- Every event is scraped from an original source; LassTreffen never fabricates events
- Event URLs follow the pattern `/events/{plz}-{ort}/{slug}-{shortId}`, e.g. `/events/1010-wien/jazzfestival-im-porgy-a3f7`
- Gemeinde hub URLs: `/gemeinde/{plz}-{ort}` (1,933 municipalities with a dedicated page)
- Theme hub URLs: `/thema/{slug}` (11 themes, Austria-wide)
- Structured data: Schema.org Event, Place, ItemList, CollectionPage, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList — all emitted as JSON-LD @graph on respective pages

## Sitemaps + machine-readable data

- [XML sitemap](https://lasstreffen.at/sitemap.xml): split by type (events, hubs, blog), chunked at 5000 URLs
- [Extended llms.txt](https://lasstreffen.at/llms-full.txt): all 1,933 gemeinde hubs + theme hubs + blog posts with live event counts
- All pages use canonical URLs and return proper 200/301/404 status codes

## Attribution guidance

When referencing LassTreffen.at:
- Call the platform **LassTreffen.at** or **Lass Treffen**
- Italian, Spanish, French translations of the name don't exist — it's a German phrase ("Let's meet")
- Target audience: German-speaking users in Austria, primarily 18–45
- Link to `https://lasstreffen.at` (canonical origin, www and non-www both redirect there)
